caption:
What Did God Do BEFORE Genesis 1:1? — The Secret Pre-Creation Council

What was God doing for eternity BEFORE Genesis 1:1? Most people assume God sat in solitary silence, alone in an infinite void waiting to create. But Jesus shattered that myth in John 17:24: 'Father, You loved Me before the foundation of the world.' Before a single galaxy spun into existence, the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit shared uncreated, infinite love. Creation was never born out of divine loneliness—it was the explosive overflow of eternal triune love.

Job 38 reveals an astonishing mystery: when God laid the earth's foundations, the Morning Stars sang together and all the sons of God (Bene Elohim) shouted for joy! Heaven was already ringing with anthems of praise long before Adam drew his first breath in Eden. Colossians 1:16 confirms that all things were created THROUGH Christ and FOR Christ. You were not an afterthought—your redemption was prepared before the foundation of the world.
